intended_use: Triage assistance on standardized screening mammography findings.
affected_people: Patients awaiting diagnosis; screening program participants; radiologists.
foreseeable_harm: False negative classification in Automatic tier: a malignant mass is mislabeled as benign and unflagged, resulting in delayed intervention and tumor progression.
mitigations: Asymmetric consequence penalty (C=1.0 for predicting benign, forcing higher risk).
Bootstrap ensemble disagreement (30 members) detects uncertain borderline lesions.
Isolation Forest anomaly detector flags unusual mass morphology.
Conservative validation percentile thresholding (p70 automatic cutoff).
Periodic retrospective audit of all unreviewed cases.
responsible_owner: Clinical Safety Officer & Lead ML Research Engineer
residual_risk: Low - False negative rate in Automatic tier reduced by >80% over unguided baseline.

intended_use: Decision support interface for radiology clinics.
affected_people: Attending radiologists; radiology residents; triage coordinators.
foreseeable_harm: Clinician automation bias: medical staff prematurely trust the 'Automatic' or 'Assisted' label without conducting independent diagnostic evaluation.
mitigations: Non-diagnostic UI disclaimers permanently affixed to every screen and report.
Presentation of separate Class Explanation (why it leans) vs Route Explanation (why it was routed).
Mandatory display of raw uncertainty (U) and anomaly (A) scores on all outputs.
Workload capacity simulations and clinical training modules on AI fallibility.
responsible_owner: Clinical Operations Lead & Human Factors Specialist
residual_risk: Acceptable with continuous clinical workflow governance and training.

affected_people: Hospital healthcare systems; radiologists; waiting list patients.
foreseeable_harm: Alert fatigue and capacity overload: excessive referrals to 'Human Review' overwhelm radiologists, increasing burnout and creating backlogs for urgent cases.
mitigations: Validation-calibrated review capacity slider dynamically tuned to department staff capacity.
Dual thresholds separating urgent full Human Review (>p90) from quick Assisted verification (p70-p90).
Workload trade-off curve monitoring in evaluation suites.
residual_risk: Low - Department controls review capacity dynamically without altering class models.

intended_use: Local inference on patient data entered into client app.
affected_people: Patients; healthcare provider data compliance team.
foreseeable_harm: Privacy violation or unauthorized leakage of protected health information (PHI) to external third-party cloud services or public LLM APIs.
mitigations: Zero cloud transmission: 100% local in-memory inference binding to loopback (::1).
Zero disk persistence of patient answers; session state discarded upon browser refresh.
Local-only optional LLM integration (Ollama loopback); strictly no telemetry.
No collection of patient identifiers (name, MRN, address, birthdate).
responsible_owner: Data Protection Officer (DPO) & Information Governance Lead
residual_risk: Negligible - Hardware boundary prevents network ingress or egress.

foreseeable_harm: Distributional drift and covariate shift: model performance degrades silently when presented with patients from unrepresented demographics or newer imaging hardware.
mitigations: Isolation Forest anomaly detector evaluates density and feature geometry against TRAIN distribution.
Cases with anomalous features (A > threshold) automatically escalated to Human Review.
Explicit fairness gap disclosure: no demographic parity claims are permitted.
Mandatory dataset datasheet and model card documenting single-center provenance.
responsible_owner: ML Quality Lead & Clinical Governance Committee
residual_risk: Monitored - Anomaly abstention actively catches out-of-distribution cases.

intended_use: User-requested natural language clinical report generation.
affected_people: Patients reading download reports; referring physicians.
foreseeable_harm: LLM hallucination or deceptive diagnostic language: report states confirmed cancer or invents symptoms, causing extreme psychological trauma or medical confusion.
mitigations: Deterministic template report by default with exact structured prediction grounding.
Rule-based explanation checker scanning for forbidden clinical phrases.
Deterministic verification of class label, route, and inputs prior to rendering.
Architecture separation: LLM has zero access to prediction and routing logic.
responsible_owner: AI Safety Officer & NLP Verification Engineer
residual_risk: Low - Multi-layer regex and assertion gates intercept ungrounded outputs.
